name: colliedesk
description: Work your Colliedesk support inbox from Cursor: the Colliedesk MCP server and skills to triage, draft replies, chase pending conversations and set up channels.

COLLIEDESK_MCP_URL.title: Colliedesk MCP address
COLLIEDESK_MCP_URL.description: Your Colliedesk address followed by /mcp, for example https://acme.colliedesk.com/mcp

COLLIEDESK_TOKEN.title: Agent token
COLLIEDESK_TOKEN.description: Create one in Colliedesk under Settings → External AI agents. It starts with cdk_agent_.
